author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Season 2 of The Brief asks creative pros across disciplines to reimagine past projects using the skills they've built since the original project. In this episode, artist and designer Mia Ghogho is tasked with upcycling a legacy fabric pattern of hers into a new print and garment. Working across Creative Cloud - using Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Fresco - Mia crafts an all-new fabric pattern and design.
